Final import from LGU-BP (archive)

LGU-BP is retired; OBO-BPMS is now the official register. Use this only once more if something was encoded in LGU-BP after the date below. Close LGU-BP first, then choose LGU-BP\DATA\bpfadru.mdf. OBO-BPMS reads the permits, assessments and professionals directly — no need to export or send the file. Current:

The CSV comes from the SQL query bundled with this app (BPFADRU-export.sql). It needs the columns type, permit_no, date_issued, name, project, barangay, address.
